strings.faction.temeria.name: Temeria
strings.faction.temeria.text: A rich northern crown of farmland and river towns, ruled from Vizima.
strings.trait.lily_crown.name: The Lily Crown
strings.trait.lily_crown.text: Every city gains +1 gold, and cities grow 10% faster.
strings.leader.foltest.name: Foltest
strings.trait.kings_peace.name: The King's Peace
strings.agenda.lion_of_vizima.name: The Lion of Vizima
strings.agenda.lion_of_vizima.text: Respects rulers who keep their word; despises surprise attacks.
strings.unit.blue_stripes.name: Blue Stripes
strings.unit.blue_stripes.text: Temeria's commandos: a scout that fights like a warrior and moves through rough country.
strings.building.royal_granary.name: Royal granary
strings.faction.redania.name: Redania
strings.faction.redania.text: The largest northern kingdom, home of great Novigrad and the scholars of Oxenfurt.
strings.trait.eyes_of_the_crown.name: Eyes of the Crown
strings.trait.eyes_of_the_crown.text: Spies cost 50% less, and the capital gains +2 science.
strings.leader.radovid.name: Radovid
strings.trait.cold_reason.name: Cold Reason
strings.agenda.steel_hand.name: The Steel Hand
strings.agenda.steel_hand.text: Admires a strong army; scorns rulers who neglect theirs.
strings.unit.redanian_crossbowman.name: Redanian crossbowman
strings.unit.redanian_crossbowman.text: Redania's archer: steadier and harder hitting than the bowmen it replaces.
strings.building.oxenfurt_college.name: Oxenfurt college
strings.faction.kaedwen.name: Kaedwen
strings.faction.kaedwen.text: A hard, mountainous kingdom on the edge of the wilds, proud of its soldiers.
strings.trait.mountain_watch.name: The Mountain Watch
strings.trait.mountain_watch.text: Walls cost 50% less; units heal 5 more each turn.
strings.leader.henselt.name: Henselt
strings.trait.iron_levy.name: The Iron Levy
strings.agenda.king_of_the_north.name: King of the North
strings.agenda.king_of_the_north.text: Wants a large realm; looks down on rulers with few cities.
strings.unit.kaedweni_halberdier.name: Kaedweni halberdier
strings.unit.kaedweni_halberdier.text: Kaedwen's spearman: a longer blade and a stubborn line.
strings.building.border_keep.name: Border keep
strings.building.border_keep.text: Kaedwen's walls: +100 city defence and +1 production.
strings.faction.aedirn.name: Aedirn
strings.faction.aedirn.text: A wealthy kingdom of mines and markets in the shadow of the Mahakam mountains.
strings.trait.dwarven_partners.name: Dwarven Partners
strings.leader.demavend.name: Demavend
strings.trait.royal_treasury.name: The Royal Treasury
strings.trait.royal_treasury.text: +2 gold in the capital and markets cost 25% less.
strings.agenda.quiet_borders.name: Quiet Borders
strings.agenda.quiet_borders.text: Values peace; hates rulers who invade their neighbours.
strings.unit.aedirnian_militia.name: Aedirnian militia
strings.unit.aedirnian_militia.text: Aedirn's warriors: cheap, plentiful and better armed than most.
strings.building.guild_exchange.name: Guild exchange
strings.faction.nilfgaard.name: Nilfgaard
strings.faction.nilfgaard.text: The great southern empire, disciplined and patient, forever pressing north across the Yaruga.
strings.trait.imperial_provinces.name: Imperial Provinces
strings.trait.imperial_provinces.text: Settlers cost 20% less; captured cities gain +10% production.
strings.leader.emhyr.name: Emhyr
strings.trait.white_flame.name: The White Flame
strings.trait.white_flame.text: +10% production in the capital and +1 culture in every city.
strings.agenda.empire_without_end.name: An Empire Without End
strings.agenda.empire_without_end.text: Admires great realms; looks down on rulers with few cities.
strings.unit.impera_guard.name: Impera Guard
strings.unit.impera_guard.text: The Emperor's elite heavy infantry, tougher than the swordsmen they replace. Needs iron.
strings.building.imperial_garrison.name: Imperial garrison
strings.faction.skellige.name: Skellige
strings.faction.skellige.text: Islands of storm-wise clans who live by the sea and the axe.
strings.trait.clans_of_the_isles.name: Clans of the Isles
strings.trait.clans_of_the_isles.text: Sea units move 1 further and cost 25% less.
strings.leader.bran.name: Bran
strings.trait.raiders_tithe.name: The Raider's Tithe
strings.trait.raiders_tithe.text: Every city gains +1 faith and +1 production.
strings.agenda.masters_of_the_sea.name: Masters of the Sea
strings.agenda.masters_of_the_sea.text: Respects a strong fleet; scorns rulers without one.
strings.unit.drakkar.name: Drakkar
strings.unit.drakkar.text: Skellige's longship: faster and harder than the galley it replaces.
strings.building.mead_hall.name: Mead hall
strings.faction.kovir.name: Kovir
strings.faction.kovir.text: A cold, rich northern realm of merchants and mines that prefers coin to war.
strings.trait.merchant_princes.name: Merchant Princes
strings.trait.merchant_princes.text: Mines give +1 gold, and banks cost 50% less.
strings.leader.esterad.name: Esterad
strings.trait.neutral_crown.name: The Neutral Crown
strings.agenda.friends_in_every_port.name: Friends in Every Port
strings.agenda.friends_in_every_port.text: Admires rulers with many friends; distrusts the isolated.
strings.unit.kovirian_cuirassier.name: Kovirian cuirassier
strings.unit.kovirian_cuirassier.text: Kovir's mercenary horse: heavier than the horsemen it replaces. Needs horses.
strings.building.counting_house.name: Counting house
strings.faction.scoiatael.name: Scoia'tael
strings.faction.scoiatael.text: Elven and dwarven commandos of the forests, fighting to win back the land of the Elder Races.
strings.trait.children_of_the_forest.name: Children of the Forest
strings.trait.children_of_the_forest.text: Forests give +1 production; land units move 1 further.
strings.leader.francesca.name: Francesca
strings.trait.daisy_of_the_valleys.name: Daisy of the Valleys
strings.trait.daisy_of_the_valleys.text: +1 culture and +1 amenity in the capital.
strings.agenda.old_blood.name: The Old Blood
strings.agenda.old_blood.text: Keeps to herself; hates rivals who settle close to her people.
strings.unit.squirrel_archer.name: Squirrel archer
strings.unit.squirrel_archer.text: The Scoia'tael's bowmen: quick through the trees, deadly from cover.
strings.building.aen_seidhe_garden.name: Aen Seidhe garden
strings.building.aen_seidhe_garden.text: The Scoia'tael's amphitheatre: +4 culture and +1 amenity. Needs a monument.
strings.building.witcher_school.name: Witcher school
strings.building.witcher_school.text: A hall where witchers are trained: lets this city train witchers. +1 science.
strings.unit.witcher.name: Witcher
strings.unit.witcher.text: A mutant monster hunter, swift and sure: +15 against monsters. Needs a witcher school.
strings.unit.drowner.name: Drowner
strings.unit.drowner.text: Pale things from the marshes that drag travellers under.
strings.unit.nekker.name: Nekker
strings.unit.nekker.text: Small, quick and many: they swarm whatever strays near their burrows.
strings.unit.ghoul.name: Ghoul
strings.unit.ghoul.text: Corpse-eaters drawn to battlefields, harder to kill than they look.
strings.unit.wyvern.name: Wyvern
strings.unit.wyvern.text: A winged beast that strikes from the sky and is gone again.
strings.religion.eternal_fire.name: The Eternal Fire
strings.religion.melitele.name: Melitele
strings.religion.old_ways.name: The Old Ways
strings.religion.great_sun.name: The Great Sun
strings.religion.kreve.name: Kreve
strings.religion.lebioda.name: Lebioda
strings.religion.freya.name: Freya
strings.event.monster_nest.name: A monster nest
strings.event.monster_nest.text: Something has made a nest in the woods near {city}. Woodcutters will not go out.
strings.event.monster_nest.choice1: Hire a witcher (-3 gold a turn for 4 turns, +1 amenity for 8 turns).
strings.event.monster_nest.choice2: Burn the woods yourselves (-2 production for 5 turns).
strings.event.wild_hunt_omen.name: The Wild Hunt
strings.event.wild_hunt_omen.text: Spectral riders were seen in the sky above {city} on a frozen night. The people are afraid.
strings.event.wild_hunt_omen.choice1: Ring every bell and pray (+3 faith, -1 amenity, both for 6 turns).
strings.event.wild_hunt_omen.choice2: Send for a sorceress to read the signs (+3 science for 6 turns, -2 gold for 6 turns).
strings.event.witch_hunters.name: Witch hunters
strings.event.witch_hunters.text: Zealots of the Eternal Fire are hunting mages and non-humans in {city}.
strings.event.witch_hunters.choice1: Let them be (+2 faith for 8 turns, -1 amenity for 8 turns).
strings.event.witch_hunters.choice2: Disband them by royal order (-1 faith for 6 turns, +1 culture for 8 turns).
strings.event.dwarven_smiths.name: Dwarven smiths
strings.event.dwarven_smiths.text: A dwarven clan from Mahakam asks to open a forge in {city}.
strings.event.dwarven_smiths.choice1: Grant them a charter (+3 production for 10 turns).
strings.event.dwarven_smiths.choice2: Tax their wares (+4 gold a turn for 6 turns).
strings.event.striga_curse.name: A cursed tower
strings.event.striga_curse.text: Folk in {city} whisper that something walks the old tower by night.
strings.event.striga_curse.choice1: Pay a witcher to lift the curse (-4 gold a turn for 5 turns).
strings.event.striga_curse.choice2: Wall the tower up and hope (-2 amenities for 6 turns).
strings.wonder.pyramids.name: The Mahakam Delvings
strings.wonder.hanging_gardens.name: The Gardens of Beauclair
strings.wonder.colossus.name: The Novigrad Harbour
strings.wonder.great_library.name: The Oxenfurt Library
strings.wonder.temple_of_artemis.name: The Temple of Melitele
strings.wonder.stonehenge.name: The Circle of Elements
strings.wonder.oracle.name: The Shrine of Hindarsfjall
strings.wonder.great_lighthouse.name: The Beacon of Cidaris
strings.mapType.inland_sea.text: Land all round a central sea, like the waters between the northern kingdoms and the Empire.
